Donald Trump avrebbe proposto la vendita di armi alla Cina a Xi Jinping. Tuttavia, le attuali leggi statunitensi lo vietano e i rischi geopolitici sono elevati.

item.title: India: Activists demand shift in addressing sexual violence
item.description:
Following recent high-profile cases of sexual assault in Bihar and Delhi, activists are calling for a focus on confronting men's behavior rather than imposing restrictions on women. The incidents have sparked national outrage and increased anxiety among Indian women.
